messages.author: 6e3dd74b422c061b
messages.subject: brms is moving to Discourse!
parts:
In order to improve the ability to support brms and the community using it, I will be deprecating the brms-users google group and migrate to the official Stan forums at http://discourse.mc-stan.org/. There, brms now has its own tag called "Interfaces - brms", which you should use to tag brms-related questions. Me and the rest of the Stan team will continue answering your questions there.

I will leave brms-users open for some more time until I will close the google group for new questions. The old questions and answers will of course remain visible.

I look forward to seeing you on the Stan Forums!

parts: I was already looking for a brms-related category in the Stan forums some time ago, and I think the larger community over there will be helpful - and probably will also allow you to relax a bit in answering questions ;-)
